title: Reconstruction of simplicial objects and morphisms from face and degeneracy operators
statement: Let $\mathcal D$ be an ordinary category and let $U_n$ be objects for all integers $n\geq0$, with maps $d_i:U_n\to U_{n-1}$ for $n\geq1$, $0\leq i\leq n$, and $s_i:U_n\to U_{n+1}$ for $0\leq i\leq n$. Suppose, whenever the composites are defined, that $d_i\circ d_j=d_{j-1}\circ d_i$ for $i<j$, $d_i\circ s_j=s_{j-1}\circ d_i$ for $i<j$, $d_j\circ s_j=1=d_{j+1}\circ s_j$, $d_i\circ s_j=s_j\circ d_{i-1}$ for $i>j+1$, and $s_i\circ s_j=s_{j+1}\circ s_i$ for $i\leq j$. Then there is a unique simplicial object $U:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal D$ [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object] whose degree objects and face and degeneracy maps are these data. For any two simplicial objects $U,V$ in $\mathcal D$, a family $f_n:U_n\to V_n$ is a morphism of simplicial objects if and only if it commutes with every face and every degeneracy map.
